subject: Human Body
title: The Ribcage
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: The Ribcage.

hook.text: You have 24 ribs forming a cage around your heart and lungs. They flex with every breath you take.

buildup.text: The top seven pairs attach directly to the sternum. Pairs 8 through 10 connect via shared cartilage.

discovery.text: The bottom two pairs float free in front. They're called floating ribs: anchored only at the spine.

twist.text: Ribs must be rigid enough to protect yet flexible enough to expand. Cartilage tips allow that flex.

climax.text: Without the ribcage, a simple fall could collapse your lungs or puncture your heart.

punchline.text: A cage that breathes with you. That's engineering.

quiz.question: What are 'floating ribs'?
options: Ribs that move freely during breathing
The bottom two pairs anchored only at the spine
